entries.title: Tree custom field
entries.summary: a new field type for multi-level choices (for example category → subcategory), alongside a reference page covering every custom field type and where each works best.

entries.title: Visit and LiveBuzz writeback field pickers
entries.summary: choose exactly which fields each connector writes back to Sessionboard instead of accepting a fixed set.

entries.title: Email and file controls
entries.summary: email campaigns can omit past recipients when re-sending, an Event Name merge tag is available in templates, and file-upload revision limits now support an admin exemption.
